summary: Meritage Homes Corp filed an 8-K to disclose entry into the Twelfth Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The amendment increases the revolving facility size to $980 million, expands the accordion feature to permit up to $1.470 billion, extends the maturity to June 24, 2031, and revises the adjusted SOFR rate. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit facilities, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. No terms related to M&A, buyback, or shareholder return are stated. The filing is a material definitive agreement and obligation creation, but does not constitute a special-situation event.
